name: Sika® SealTape B
tagline: A next generation hybrid self-adhesive sealing tape designed for use with water-based waterproofing membranes
summary: Self-adhesive waterproofing tape for flexible and waterproof of areas at risk of cracking (wall corners, floor-to-wall connections, pipelines etc.).
metaDescription: Self-adhesive waterproofing tape for flexible and waterproof of areas at risk of cracking (wall corners, floor-to-wall connections, pipelines etc.).
attributes: Contains PE Foil liner for 100% waterproofing protection
Multi component bandage for maximum protection
Non woven fleece than doesnt prevent elongation unlike other self adhesives butyl tapes
Bonding well with the waterproofing compound
Strong adhesion on a wide range of substrates
Bonds to PVC control leak flanges and metal channel drains without a primer.
usage: Sealing together between wall/floor surfaces and other change of planes including shower niches in wet rooms such as bathrooms and showers
Sealing together between tile and slab surfaces on balconies, terraces and on façades
Waterproof terminations such as water stop angles.
System component for the SikaCeram Sealing membrane A

items.label: Composition
items.text:
Sika® SealTape B
Backing tape | Release liner
Sealing layer: | Polyethylene (PE Foil)
Fleece: | Polyester (PES) non woven
Adhesive: | Butyl

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: In original, unopened, sealed and undamaged packaging: 12 months from date of production

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Storage temperature between +5 °C and +30 °C. Store in dry conditions. Protect from direct sunlight.

items.label: Compatibility
items.text:
Sika® SealTape B is suitable for use with the folowing Sika waterproofing products
SikaTile under tile waterproofing membranes
Sikalastic WPU
Sikalastic 1K
SikaCeram Sealing Membrane A
Davco under tile waterproofing membranes

items.label: Flexural-strength
items.text:
Breaking load Longitudinal: 49N / 15mm
Breaking load Lateral: 37N / 15mm
Peel Test on Neutral PVC carrier: .13N / 20mm
Burst pressure: 2.0 bar

items.label: Substrate temperature
items.text:
in. +5°C, max. +35°C
Avoid applications in hot direct sun above 30°C

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text:
The substrate must be secure, ready to take loads as well as free of oil, grease, dust and other separating layers.
A primer is recommended prior to application, refer the the specific instructions on the relevant product data sheet of the Sika waterproofing membrane.
Priming of PVC control leak flanges and metal channel drains are not required. Apply the Sika® SealTape B directly onto the surface and use a small roller flatten and avoid air pockets.
